'''Group Captain''' was a military rank. It was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Klick (clone trooper)/Legends|Klick]] held the the position of Group Captain during his time in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]].

This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
